metadata.title: Hansung Electronics | Cable Harness Manufacturer
metadata.description: Hansung Electronics is a Samsung Electronics Tier-1 vendor specializing in cable harness and wire harness manufacturing. Founded in 1992, expanding into Robotics & AI Server sectors.

home.aboutDesc: Since its establishment in 1992, Hansung Electronics has been supplying the highest quality products to global companies including Samsung Electronics, backed by accumulated expertise in cable harness and electronic component manufacturing.
home.businessDesc: Beyond our core cable harness manufacturing, Hansung is pursuing new business ventures to secure future growth engines.
home.cableHarnessDesc: High-quality wire harness and cable assembly manufacturing. Meeting the strictest quality standards as a Samsung Electronics Tier-1 vendor.
home.strategicMaDesc: Pursuing strategic mergers and acquisitions to strengthen technological competitiveness and expand business reach.
home.ctaDesc: Let Hansung's expertise provide the optimal solution for your needs.

ceo.title: CEO Message
ceo.subtitle: Spread beautiful dreams with true passion
ceo.greeting: Thank you for visiting the Hansung Electronics website.
ceo.quote: Hansung Electronics is a company where members who understand sincerity, dreams, and elegance gather together, striving tirelessly to deliver the highest level of satisfaction to our customers.
ceo.body1: Our core value is to pour passion rooted in sincerity, realize our dreams through united strength, and our ultimate goal is to receive heartfelt praise from our customers for the products and services we provide.
ceo.body2: The deep love and interest from our customers has brought us to where we are today. We will stand tall like an even greater mountain tomorrow, becoming a brilliant light for everyone who loves Hansung.
ceo.body3: We will also fulfill our responsibilities and duties to our neighbors and society, striving to become a company that knows gratitude. We look forward to your continued support and encouragement.
